title: Suriya's Scene Passes Jana Nayagan in North America in Under Five Days
excerpt: The Tamil film has grossed $1.655 million in the US and Canada before its first Tuesday finished, becoming Kollywood's third-highest grosser of 2026 in the territory — trade estimates put its worldwide gross past Rs 150 crore in four days.
body:
• Scene, Suriya's Tamil dark comedy directed by Jithu Madhavan, has grossed $1.655 million (about Rs 15.51 crore) in North America in under five days, according to Koimoi's trade tracking.
  • That total passes the lifetime North American collection of Vijay's Jana Nayagan ($1.58 million), making Scene Kollywood's third-highest grosser of 2026 in the territory, behind Jailer 2 ($7.87 million) and Vishwanath & Sons ($2.95 million).
  • The film bounced on its first Tuesday — $185,000 and counting, up from Monday's $128,000 — helped by Discount Tuesday pricing.
  • All figures are trade estimates, not producer figures; Sacnilk put the worldwide gross at Rs 153.60 crore after four days.

Suriya's run in North America now has a third entry. Scene, the Tamil-language dark comedy directed by Jithu Madhavan, crossed $1.655 million in the United States and Canada before final numbers for its first Tuesday were in, passing the lifetime North American total of Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan in less than five days.

The day-by-day climb

Koimoi's day-wise breakdown shows how the film got there: $236,000 from premieres, $310,000 on day one, a peak of $441,000 on day two, $332,000 on day three, a Monday dip to $128,000, and then $185,000 and counting on Tuesday, when discounted ticket pricing lifted the take. Filmverse, citing tracker Venky Box Office, reported the film's first three days at about $1.34 million — $958,000 from the USA and $382,000 from Canada, with the Tamil version contributing $1.04 million — making it Suriya's fourth million-dollar grosser in the territory and his third this year, after Karuppu and Vishwanath & Sons.

"At home, Sacnilk reported an India net of Rs 21.40 crore on day four and a worldwide gross of Rs 153.60 crore, noting that overseas figures are rough estimates."

Where it sits in 2026

With $1.655 million, Scene ranks third among Kollywood releases of 2026 in North America: behind Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 at $7.87 million and Suriya's own Vishwanath & Sons at $2.95 million, and ahead of Jana Nayagan ($1.58 million) and Karuppu ($1.4 million). Three of the year's top five in the territory are now Suriya films. At home, Sacnilk reported an India net of Rs 21.40 crore on day four and a worldwide gross of Rs 153.60 crore, noting that overseas figures are rough estimates.

About the film

Scene is in Tamil, with a Telugu version also in theatres. It stars Suriya alongside Naslen and Nazriya Nazim, and is produced by Suriya, Jyothika and Jaishree Damodaran under Zhagaram Studios and 2D Entertainment. On BookMyShow it is rated 9.1 out of 10 from more than 118,000 votes, per Koimoi. For diaspora viewers, the film is in its first week in US and Canadian theatres now; its second weekend will decide whether it closes in on Vishwanath & Sons.
